findings.claim_text: On 2026-04-18, 116,500 rsETH (about $292M) was taken from Kelp's bridge; Aave-specific bad-debt exposure was roughly $196M, Aave's TVL fell from $26.4B to nearly $20B, and AAVE dropped 16% to $92.
findings.contradicting_quote: Aave was left with $124.5M of bad debt... Aave wrote off its loss on May 6, 2026

findings.claim_text: Morpho's TVL as share of Aave's: 68%, from 19% at 2025-09-01, as of 2026-11-16 (DefiLlama figures of $15.11B vs $10.22B TVL)

DefiLlama's 30-day fees on 2026-11-19 were $42.0M for Aave and $34.1M for Morpho, with trailing-year fees of $601.8M and $214.9M, so Aave's 30-day fees were about 1.23 times Morpho's, but about 2.8 times over the year.
